descripcion: NEW STREET, 4. La tia murio en Hampstead, a seis millas. La sobrina no sabe mas: lo sabe su casa de Hampstead, y el carro de la fabrica sube cada dia.
_de_que_va: Va de la distancia; el agua se sabe en Hampstead.
_guion: Texto del Guion jugable del Acto I.

abre.texto: No one in this house has died, Reverend. But my aunt has.

la_tia.texto: She died in Hampstead on Saturday. She had not set foot in Soho for months.

otra_vez.texto: The carter for the factory is in Broad Street, Reverend. He goes up to Hampstead every day.

el_carro.texto: Her sons have the cap factory in Broad Street. Their carter drives up to her house every day. Ask him, if you want to know more.
